article_content: A series of images have emerged depicting the destruction of nearly a dozen ancient shrines and Shia mosques in ISIS-controlled territory in western Iraq. The photographs, showing the devastation in Mosul, Iraq's second largest city, and the town of Tal Afar, were posted on a website known for carrying official statements from the Islamic State extremist group. Some images display bulldozers tearing through walls, while others capture buildings being demolished by explosives, resulting in clouds of smoke and rubble. Residents from both Mosul and Tal Afar have confirmed the destruction of these sites, according to the Associated Press. Sunni extremists view Shia Muslims as heretics and consider the veneration of saints as apostasy. A Twitter feed attributed to ISIS described the destroyed buildings as pagan 'temples'. 'We feel very sad for the demolition of these shrines, which we inherited from our fathers and grandfathers,' said Ahmed, a 51-year-old Mosul resident, as reported by the Times of India. He added, 'They are landmarks in the city.' Meanwhile, Iraqi security agencies are working to verify the authenticity of a video purportedly showing the leader of Islamic State, Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, delivering a sermon at the Great Mosque in Mosul. The video, reportedly filmed on Friday, was posted on websites used by the organization and bore the logo of its media arm. This sermon in Mosul would mark the first public appearance for al-Baghdadi, a shadowy figure who has become a prominent figure in the international jihadi community. Al-Baghdadi, who has a $10 million U.S. bounty on his head, took over the group four years ago and has since transformed it from an al-Qaida affiliate focused on Iraq into an independent transnational force controlling a vast area straddling the Syria-Iraq border. Among the images that have emerged is a photo of the Shia Jawad Husseiniya mosque in Tal Afar, Iraq, destroyed in a cloud of dust and rubble following an explosion. Iraqi military spokesman Lt. Gen. Qassim al-Moussawi told reporters that the country's security services are analyzing the 21-minute video to verify whether the speaker is indeed al-Baghdadi, and that the government will announce the details once available. The purported appearance in Mosul, a city of some 2 million that the militants seized last month, came five days after al-Baghdadi's group declared the establishment of an Islamic state, or caliphate, in the territories it has seized in Iraq and Syria. The group proclaimed al-Baghdadi the leader of its state and demanded that all Muslims pledge allegiance to him.

article_content: Valuations in Indian large-caps are reasonable, and we expect 15% or more earnings growth in the next couple of years,' says Mihir Vora, Chief Investment Officer, TRUST Mutual Fund. Vora, therefore, expects large-cap index returns to be in line with the earnings growth but added that a global economic slowdown could temper these returns. Edited excerpts from an interview with ETMarkets: Despite the strong rally, several money managers still see a lot of opportunities in the midcap and smallcap segments. What are your thoughts? Some mid and small-cap stocks may have run a bit too far, but that does not mean the whole segment is expensive. This space will always be a stock picker’s canvas, and there are a couple of reasons for this. One is the sheer number of companies and sub-sectors to choose from – there are over 3000 listed companies, out of which large-caps are only 100 or 3% in terms of numbers. So, the universe of mid, small, and microcaps is very large. Second is the fact that most of the new, upcoming, and exciting sectors where we expect high growth are represented only in the mid and small space. Sectors and sub-sectors like capital goods, defense, railways capex, electronics and durable manufacturing, construction, renewable power, power transmission & distribution, China-plus-one theme plays, beneficiaries of the production-linked schemes, chemical and pharma companies, etc., are mostly represented only in the mid and small-cap space. As an asset manager, what’s your strategy for seeking alpha returns? Investing is ultimately an act of wisdom, not only intellect and intelligence. We believe in having a distinct approach and have proved the same when we launched our fixed-income funds with many innovative features like proprietary indices, limited-active approach, and tie-up with CRISIL. We want to be consistent in what we say and what we do. We do not believe in proliferation and will offer distinct true-to-label products. So, what’s your outlook for equities over the next 1 year? Valuations in Indian large-caps are reasonable, and we expect 15% or more earnings growth in the next couple of years. So the large-cap index returns should be in line with earnings growth. The risk remains that of a global economy slowdown, which can temper these returns. In the run-up to the general elections, will one see major rejigs in portfolios in your view? We can expect more support for the lower-income segments in the next few months. It may be populistic, but it’s necessary as the rural economy is still sluggish, and in general, the lower-end income and savings still seem weaker than that for the higher-income groups. So, there may be some mini-stimulus effects. While I would not make dramatic changes to the current views, I’ll observe the news flow for the above developments. PSU Banks have already outperformed private sector ones by a wide margin. Would you still be buyers in the former? Public-sector banks have done quite well in the past year. Part of the outperformance was due to improving fundamentals and partly it was due to the valuations catching up, as the private sector banks had rallied massively between 2020 and 2022. While there is still a considerable valuation difference in public-sector banks versus the private banks, the best of the outperformance may be past us. I would stick to the larger banks in the public sector now. What’s the outlook for domestic institutional inflows in the near term? Do you see it outpacing FII flows? The outlook for domestic institutional flows has never been better. Mutual fund SIPs, insurance premiums, National Pension Scheme, and Employees Provident Fund flows to equities are now over Rs 20,000 crore per month. These provide a big support to the market, which was not the case 5-10 years ago. Domestic flows will outpace foreign flows if this continues. The manufacturing theme has gained a lot of attention in India, partly due to the China+1 strategy. What is your view for this sector and/or what big opportunities are likely for investors? We cannot achieve a GDP growth of more than 5-6% without creating physical assets and manufacturing value-add. The government has taken significant steps to encourage local manufacturing in the past 5 years. Manufacturing companies in segments like mobile phone manufacturing, white-good production, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, automobiles and components, etc., are likely to grow much faster than the rest of the economy. So, the preferred sectors are domestic-focused. Fundamentally, I believe that we are on the cusp of an investments-led growth phase in manufacturing, infrastructure creation, and real estate. So capital goods, construction, real estate, defense manufacturing, railway investments, etc., are the sub-sectors which should see significant momentum in the next few years. Apart from these physical-asset creating sectors, financials look good. Banking and financials are the largest sector, and these are expected to drive earnings growth as they are in a sweet spot with the pick-up in credit growth. Amid the prevailing global and domestic factors, what kind of asset allocation strategy can help a retail investor balance risk and returns? Asset allocation is a function of the individual’s unique situation, so it is not right to recommend a number or ‘ideal’ mix. However, let’s look at equities versus fixed-income. Three years ago, when we had equities crashing due to COVID, valuations had become too attractive. Also, interest rates were cut to record low levels. So, equities was by far the best bet. Now equities valuations have normalized while fixed income rates are at high levels. So, relatively fixed-income has become more attractive too. One can look at increasing allocation to fixed income. Globally, we are beginning to see signs of the US dollar depreciation and this is potentially positive for gold. So, some small diversification into gold can also be considered as a portfolio strategy.
translated_content: Thamani za hisa kubwa za Uhindi zinazofaa na tunatarajia kukua kwa mapato ya 15% au zaidi katika miaka ijayo mbili,' anasema Mihir Vora, Mwenyekiti wa Shirika la Uwekezaji, Kikundi cha TRUST. Vora, hivyo, anatarajia mapato ya fomu ya hisa kubwa yatakayolingana na kukua kwa mapato lakini aliongeza kwamba uchumi wa kimataifa unaweza kudidimiza mapato hayo. Sehemu zilizochaguliwa kutoka mahojiano na ETMarkets: Bila kujali kupanda kwa nguvu, wengi wa wadau wa fedha bado wanaona nafasi nyingi katika sehemu za hisa za kati na ndogo. Je, maoni yako ni lipi? Hisa za kati na ndogo zinazofaa zinaweza kuendelea kidogo zaidi, lakini hii si maana ya kwamba sehemu yote ni ghali. Hii eneo itabaki kitabu cha wachaguzi wa hisa, na kuna sababu mbili za hii. Moja ni idadi kubwa ya kampuni na sehemu za kufanya kazi kutoka kuchagua – kuna zaidi ya kampuni 3000 zilizoorodheshwa, ambapo hisa kubwa ni 100 tu au 3% katika idadi. Kwa hivyo, ulimwengu wa hisa za kati, ndogo na mikrodogo ni kubwa sana. Pili ni hakika ya kwamba seheta zinazokuja na zinazokuja zilizo na ukuaji mkubwa zinawakilishwa katika eneo la kati na ndogo tu. Sehemu na sehemu za kufanya kazi kama vile bidhaa za mikondo, ulinzi, kujenga reli capex, elektroniki na utengenezaji wa bidhaa zilizodumu, ujenzi, nishati mbadala, usambazaji wa umeme na utawala, michezo ya mbinu ya China-plus-one, washikaji wa mipango ya uzalishaji iliyohusishwa, kampuni za kemikali na madawa, n.k., zinawakilishwa katika eneo la hisa za kati na ndogo tu. Kama mudiri wa mali, ni nini shabaha yako ya kutafuta mapato ya alpha? Uwekezaji ni hatimaye tendo la hekima, si tu akili na ujanja. Tunadhamini kuwa na njia tofauti na tumethibitisha hivi katika kipindi ambapo tulianzisha zile za mapato ya thabiti na makubaliano mengi mpya kama vile fomu za kibinafsi, njia ya kufanya kazi chini ya kiwango cha juu, na kufunga mikono na CRISIL. Tunataka kuwa na uimara katika tunachosema na tunachofanya. Hatutaki kupanua na tutatoa bidhaa tofauti za kufaa. Basi, je, utazamaji wako wa hisa katika miaka 1 ijayo ni lipi? Thamani za hisa kubwa za Uhindi zinazofaa na tunatarajia kukua kwa mapato ya 15% au zaidi katika miaka ijayo mbili. Kwa hivyo mapato ya fomu ya hisa kubwa yatakayolingana na kukua kwa mapato. Hatari inabaki ya uchumi wa kimataifa kudidimiza, ambayo inaweza kudidimiza mapato hayo. Katika kuongozwa kwa uchaguzi mkuu, utaona majadiliano makubwa katika mifuko katika maoni yako? Tunaweza kutarajia zaidi ya msaada kwa sehemu za mapato chini katika miezi ijayo. Inaweza kuwa ya kisiasa, lakini ni lazima tangu uchumi wa vijijini bado ni dhaifu, na pamoja na uchumi wa mapato chini na uokozi ni dhaifu zaidi kuliko kwa watu wenye mapato ya juu. Kwa hivyo, kunaweza kuwa athari za mini-stimulus. Ingawa singeliweza kufanya mabadiliko makubwa kwa maoni ya sasa, nitazingatia mtiririko wa habari kwa ajili ya maendeleo haya. Benki za umma tayari zimepita kufanya vizuri zaidi ya zile za sekta binafsi kwa kiasi kikubwa. Je, bado ungewaunga mkono katika benki za awali? Benki za umma zimefanya vizuri katika mwaka uliopita. Sehemu ya ufanisi wa kufanya vizuri zaidi ilikuwa kutokana na msingi wa kufanya vizuri na sehemu ilikuwa kutokana na thamani kufikia, kama benki za sekta binafsi zilikuwa zimepanda kwa kasi kati ya 2020 na 2022. Kuna tofauti kubwa ya thamani katika benki za umma dhidi ya benki za binafsi, lakini yaliyofanya vizuri zaidi inaweza kuwa nyuma sisi. Ningekaa na benki kubwa katika sekta ya umma sasa. Je, utazamaji wa mienendo ya kitaifa ya kitaifa katika muda mfupi ni ipi? Unaiona ikiendelea kupita mienendo ya WFI? Utazamaji wa mienendo ya kitaifa ya kitaifa haukawa wakati wowote vizuri. Mapato ya SIP ya kikundi cha pesa, ada za bima, Mpango wa Pension ya Kitaifa, na mapato ya Chama cha Wafanyakazi kwa Hisa sasa zina zaidi ya Rs 20,000 kila mwezi. Hizi hutoa msaada kubwa kwa soko, ambalo haukawa wakati wowote 5-10 miaka iliyopita. Mienendo ya ndani itaendelea kupita mienendo ya nje ikiendelea hivi. Ukurasa wa utengenezaji umepokea umaarufu mwingi katika Uhindi, sehemu kutokana na mbinu ya China+1. Je, maoni yako kwa ajili ya seheta hii na/au nafasi kubwa zinazotarajiwa kwa wauwekezaji? Hatutoweza kufikia ukuaji wa GDP ya zaidi ya 5-6% bila kuunda mali halisi na ongezeko la thamani ya utengenezaji. Serikali imefanya hatua muhimu kuhimiza utengenezaji wa ndani katika miaka 5 iliyopita. Kampuni za utengenezaji katika sehemu kama vile utengenezaji wa simu za mkononi, utengenezaji wa bidhaa nyeupe, kemikali, madawa, magari na vipengee, n.k., zinaweza kukua haraka zaidi kuliko uchumi wote. Kwa hivyo, sehemu zinazotarajiwa ni zinazohusiana na ndani. Kimsingi, ninaamini kwamba tume karibu na kipindi cha kukua cha uwekezaji katika utengenezaji, uumbaji wa miundo na mali halisi. Kwa hivyo, bidhaa za mikondo, ujenzi, mali halisi, utengenezaji wa ulinzi, michango ya reli, n.k., ni sehemu zinazotarajiwa zitakazoendelea na kasi katika miaka ijayo. Isipokuwa sehemu hizo zinazounda mali halisi, fedha zinazofaa. Fedha na fedha ni sehemu kubwa zaidi, na zinatarajiwa kukuza ukuaji wa mapato kama ziko katika nafasi nzuri na kupanuka kwa mkopo. Kati ya visukuu vya kimataifa na vya ndani vinavyoshughulikiwa, aina gani ya shabaha ya kugawanya mali inaweza kusaidia muwekezaji wa kawaida kulenga hatari na mapato? Kugawanya mali ni sharti la hali ya mtu binafsi, kwa hivyo si sahihi kutaja namba au 'mchanganyiko wa kipekee'. Lakini tuzingatie hisa dhidi ya mapato ya thabiti. Miaka mitatu iliyopita, tulipotea hisa kutokana na COVID, thamani zilikuwa zimefanya kuwa na faida. Pia, kadiri ya kiasi cha fedha ilikuwa imepunguzwa hadi kiwango cha rekodi. Kwa hivyo, hisa ilikuwa chaguo bora kabisa. Sasa thamani za hisa zimewekwa wakfu na kadiri ya fedha ya thabiti ziko katika viwango vya juu. Kwa hivyo, pia mapato ya thabiti yamefanya kuwa na faida. Mmoja anaweza kuangalia kuongeza ugawaji wa mapato ya thabiti. Kimataifa, tunazidi kuona alama za kushuka kwa dola ya Marekani na hii ni kipenyo kwa dhahabu. Kwa hivyo, kipengee kidogo katika dhahabu pia inaweza kukaribishwa kama shabaha ya kugawanya mali.

article_content: The iconic British rock band, The Kinks, might be making a comeback with a new album and tour, inspired by the success of a recent play about their rise in the 1960s. Led by brothers Ray and Dave Davies, the band is renowned for hits like 'Lola' and has had a significant influence on British rock music. Despite their turbulent history, including a bitter breakup in 1996, Ray Davies has recently suggested that a reunion could be on the cards. The Davies brothers' complex relationship, characterized by intense disputes, both fueled their creative success and led to their eventual split. Their music has inspired numerous other bands, such as Oasis and Blur. The well-received musical 'Sunny Afternoon', which chronicles The Kinks' journey to stardom, may have played a role in reigniting reunion discussions. The Kinks, who hail from Muswell Hill, North London, were inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 1990, and Ray Davies was awarded a CBE in 2004 for his contributions to music. Their legacy continues to inspire, and fans are hopeful that the brothers can set aside their differences and collaborate once again.

Bendi hii inayoongozwa na ndugu Ray na Dave Davies inajulikana kwa nyimbo kama 'Lola' na imekuwa na athiri kubwa katika muziki wa rock wa Uingereza. article_content: Scotland has a knack for scoring goals that are both spectacular and ultimately inconsequential. From Archie Gemmill's stunning solo effort against Holland in 1978 to Gordon Strachan's precise finish against Germany in 1986, Scotland has often produced memorable moments that don't translate into wins. When Ikechi Anya scored against Manuel Neuer to equalize in Dortmund last month, it seemed like a break from this pattern. Unfortunately, the final result was still a 2-1 loss to the world champions. Despite the defeat, Anya celebrated his achievement, expressing his disbelief on Twitter at scoring against one of the world's best goalkeepers, something he couldn't even do in a video game. Reflecting on his career highlight with a mix of pride and regret, Anya, who hails from Castlemilk, is determined not to let this moment be a one-off. 'When you experience something like that, you want to work twice as hard to feel it again,' he said. 'I don't want to be remembered just for scoring against Germany. We lost the game, so it wasn't even a winning goal. I want to be part of the team that qualifies for Euro 2016.' Anya believes that playing with top-quality teammates and having the support of his coach will help him improve without becoming complacent. Anya's journey to this point has been remarkable. From his early days taking multiple buses to training at Wycombe to his stints with various Spanish B teams and eventually finding success through Glenn Hoddle's academy and Watford, his dedication has paid off. Born to a Nigerian research assistant and a Romanian economist, Anya dreamt of playing at Ibrox. Next month, he'll finally get his chance when Scotland faces Georgia in a crucial Euro 2016 qualifier. 'I didn't attend games as a kid, but I watched them on TV,' Anya recalled. 'Playing at Ibrox for Scotland will be a big deal for me.' Looking ahead, Anya is optimistic about Scotland's chances. 'We went into the Germany game intending to win,' he said. 'We were tentative in the first half but improved in the second. We'll approach the upcoming games against Georgia and Poland with the same mindset.' Anya praises the intensity and quality of the current Scotland squad, believing they have a real chance to qualify. 'It will be seen as a failure if we don't qualify,' he noted. 'We need to take responsibility and use our performance against Germany as a benchmark to win more games.' Tickets for the Georgia vs. Scotland match at Ibrox on October 11 are available through the Scottish FA website or by phone.
translated_content: Uskoti ina uwezo wa kufunga magoli yanayoweza kuwa ya kushangaza na yasiyofaa. Kutoka kwenye mchezo wa pekee wa Archie Gemmill dhidi ya Uholanzi mwaka 1978 hadi kufunga kwa Gordon Strachan dhidi ya Ujerumani mwaka 1986, Uskoti mara nyingi imetengeneza muda mazuri ambayo hayafanikiwi kuwa ushindi. Ikechi Anya alipofunga dhidi ya Manuel Neuer kuweka sawa huko Dortmund mwezi uliopita, ilikuwa kama mabadiliko ya mwenendo huo. Hata hivyo, matokeo ya mwisho yalikuwa ushindi wa 2-1 dhidi ya wapenzi wa dunia. Hata baada ya ushindi huo, Anya alifurahia mafanikio yake, akiongea juu ya hilo kwenye Twitter kuhusu kuwa hana imani ya kufunga dhidi ya mlinzi bora wa dunia, jambo ambalo hangeweza kufanya katika michezo ya kompyuta. Akirudia kumbukumbu yake ya kazi ya maisha yake na mchanganyiko wa faraja na huzuni, Anya, ambaye anatoka Castlemilk, anaazimia kuwa haikuwa muda mmoja tu. 'Unapopata tukio kama hilo, unataka kufanya kazi mara mbili zaidi ili uifeze tena,' alisema. 'Sina tama ya kumbukwa kama mtu ambaye alifunga dhidi ya Ujerumani tu. Tulipoteza mchezo, kwa hiyo siyo lengo la ushindi. Ninataka kuwa sehemu ya timu inayofanikiwa kufuzu kwa Euro 2016.' Anya anaamini kwamba kucheza na wachezaji wa hali ya juu na kupokea msaada wa kocha wake, ataweza kuboresha bila kuwa na dharau. Safari yake hadi kufikia hapa imekuwa ya kushangaza. Kutoka siku zake za awali za kuchukua basi nyingi hadi mafunzo ya Wycombe hadi kipindi chake na timu mbalimbali za Hispania na mwishowe kupata mafanikio kupitia chuo cha Glenn Hoddle na Watford, ustadi wake umezaa matokeo. Alizaliwa na msaidizi wa utafiti wa Nigeria na mchumi wa Romania, Anya alikuwa anaota kucheza Ibrox. Mwezi ujao, atapata nafasi yake ya kwanza wakati Uskoti utakaribia Georgia katika mechi muhimu wa kufuzu kwa Euro 2016. 'Siku zilizopita hakunipende kuenda michezo, lakini nilitazama katika televisheni,' Anya alirudia. 'Kucheza Ibrox kwa Uskoti kitakuwa ni jambo kubwa kwangu.' Akitazama mbele, Anya anaona nafasi njema za Uskoti. 'Tulingia mchezo dhidi ya Ujerumani na tulitaka kushinda,' alisema. 'Tulikuwa na wasiwasi nusu ya kwanza lakini tuliboresha katika nusu ya pili. Tutaitumia mwelekeo huo katika mechi zinazokuja dhidi ya Georgia na Poland. Anya anashangaza na ustadi na hali ya timu ya sasa ya Uskoti, akiwa na imani kwamba wana nafasi njema ya kufuzu. 'Kitakuonekana kama shindano kama hatutafuzu,' alieleza. 'Tunahitaji kuchukua jukumu hili na kutumia utendaji wetu dhidi ya Ujerumani kama msingi wa kushinda mechi zaidi.' Tiketi za mechi ya Georgia dhidi ya Uskoti katika uwanja wa Ibrox tarehe 11 Oktoba ziko katika tovuti ya Scottish FA au kupitia simu.

article_content: By Aladair Glennie and Ben Spencer Middle-aged professional men who vote Conservative are the most likely to be involved in road rage incidents, according to a recent study. Cyclists, drivers, and pedestrians who engage in such altercations are typically in their 40s or 50s, Conservative, and well-off. A YouGov poll of 1,900 British adults revealed that 43% of respondents have experienced road rage. The figures coincide with the screening of a new ITV documentary titled 'Road Rage Britain'. The documentary highlights that 43% of people have been involved in road rage incidents. It also notes that one in five individuals admit to acts of anger directed at others. With more cars on the roads and an increase in cycling, competition for limited road space has intensified, leading to frequent and furious disputes. The ITV documentary, set to air this evening, showcases some of the most shocking acts of violence committed by drivers and cyclists. Using footage from helmet-mounted and dashboard cameras, the program delves into the pressures faced by commuters. In one segment, a well-dressed middle-aged man in red trousers, a shirt, and a V-necked pullover engages in a physical altercation with a cyclist. The enraged driver lifts the bicycle over his head and slams it down on his opponent. The program includes an experiment where two cyclists swap transportation modes with a London cab driver and a white van driver to explore the root causes of road rage. Cycle courier Nick Swinden, 37, from Archway, London, recounts being chased by various drivers and experiencing physical altercations. Preston-based white van driver Gaz McPartland, 38, expresses his frustration with cyclists, stating that since he pays road tax, he should have priority on the road. He questions why cyclists, who do not pay tax, should be allowed to ride in groups. 'Road Rage Britain: Caught on Camera' will be broadcast at 9 pm on ITV tonight.

article_content: Charles Ashton (pictured) avoided jail despite groping a woman's breast and kissing her on the cheek during a funeral service. An elderly undertaker, shamed for his actions, walked free from court after admitting to sexually assaulting a woman at a funeral. Charles Ashton, the disgraced funeral director, also made lewd remarks about the woman's figure before kissing her on the lips, as reported in court. District Judge Roy Anderson fined Ashton £600 and told the 83-year-old that his reputation was 'shredded,' but spared him jail due to his advanced age. Judge Anderson addressed the defendant, saying, 'You were a respected undertaker, but you have brought utter shame and disgrace upon yourself. She was a victim of your reprehensible sexual harassment, the effects of which still haunt her today. Were it not for your age, I would handle this matter more severely. However, I will impose a financial penalty instead. Your tarnished reputation is a significant factor in this decision.' Prosecutor Amanda Harris described the incident at Leeds Magistrates Court, detailing how it occurred at a crematorium in Leeds, West Yorkshire, during a service conducted by Ashton's family business. Harris stated, 'He asked her to sit beside him, and she agreed out of politeness. He then put his arms around her, grabbed her shoulder, and made sexual comments, including 'you don't get many of those to the gallon,' referring to her breasts.' Harris added that Ashton squeezed the woman's right breast, pulled her head towards him, and kissed her on the cheek, saying he wanted a proper kiss before placing his lips on hers. Defense lawyer Stephen Swan described the incident as 'a moment of madness,' stating that Ashton was deeply remorseful and devastated by his actions. Swan mentioned that Ashton, from Castleford, West Yorkshire, still assists at the family business run by his sons. Judge Anderson fined Ashton £600 and ordered him to pay £85 towards prosecution costs. The judge warned Ashton that any future offenses would result in a more severe penalty. Ashton, who pleaded guilty to sexual assault by touching, must also pay the victim £1,000 in compensation and adhere to a five-year restraining order prohibiting any contact with her. Upon leaving the court, Ashton asked reporters, 'Are you going to hang me? Are you going to hang me again?'
translated_content: Charles Ashton (aliyeonekana picha) ameweza kuwa huru kutoka kwenye mahakama kwa kumshika mtu mmoja kwa kumnyonya na kumpiga mkono wakati wa huduma ya mazishi. Mzee mwenye kazi ya kumzika, aliyefanyiwa aibu kwa matendo yake, ametembea huru kutoka kwenye mahakama baada ya kukubali kuwa amelengwa mwanamke mmoja wakati wa mazishi. Charles Ashton, mkurugenzi wa mazishi aliyefanyiwa aibu, pia alitoa maoni chafu kuhusu umbo la mwanamke kabla ya kumpiga mkono kwenye shingo, kadiri ya mahakama. Hakimu wa Wilaya Roy Anderson amempa Ashton adhibiti ya pauni 600 na akamwambia mzee wa miaka 83 kwamba sifa yake imekatwa, lakini amemruhusu awe huru kwa sababu ya umri wake mkuu. Hakimu Anderson akimwambia madai, 'Ulikuwa mkurugenzi mwenye heshima, lakini umetoa aibu na uchungu kwa njia yako mwenyewe. Yeye alikuwa mshindi wa unyanyasaji wa ngono uliyo dhihirishi, athari zake zinamuumba hadi leo. Sio kwa sababu ya umri wako ningefanya jambo hili kwa njia inayohitaji zaidi. Lakini nitafanya hili kwa njia ya adhabu ya fedha. Sifa yako iliyokatwa ni kitu muhimu katika maamuzi haya.' Mwanasheria wa kuendesha kesi Amanda Harris alieleza tukio hilo katika Mahakama ya Leeds, akieleza jinsi ilivyotokea katika makaburi ya Leeds, West Yorkshire, wakati wa huduma iliyofanywa na biashara ya familia ya Ashton. Harris alisema, 'Alimwuliza akae pembeni mwake, na yeye akakubali kwa upole. Akaja akamshika kwa mikono yake, akamshika shikio na kutoa maoni ya ngono, ikiwa ni pamoja na 'hukupata mengi ya hayo kwa galoni', akitaja mabeste yake.' Harris aliongeza kwamba Ashton amemshika mkono wa kulia wa mwanamke, akamvuta kichwa kwake kwake na kumpiga mkono kwenye shikio, akisema alitaka busu halisi kabla ya kumwekea shingo. Wakili wa ulinzi Stephen Swan alieleza tukio hilo kuwa 'nyakati ya upungufu wa akili', akisema kwamba Ashton alikuwa na huzuni kubwa na kuangazwa na matendo yake. Swan alisema kwamba Ashton, kutoka Castleford, West Yorkshire, bado anasaidia katika biashara ya familia inayoendeshwa na wanawe. Hakimu Anderson amempa Ashton adhibiti ya pauni 600 na kumwekea mwenye kesi kulipa pauni 85 kwa gharama za kesi. Hakimu alimwonya Ashton kwamba matendo yoyote ya baadaye yatamleta adhabu inayohitaji zaidi. Ashton, ambaye amekubali kuhusika na unyanyasaji wa ngono kwa kumshika, pia lazima apate mwanamke faini ya pauni 1,000 na kufuata amri ya kumzuia kwa miaka mitano kutokana na mawasiliano yoyote naye. Baada ya kuondoka kwenye mahakama, Ashton aliwauliza wahariri, 'Je, mnaniweka mkononi? Je, mnaniweka mkononi tena?'
